versions.subject: fix: key/value
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'shell32.dll'
        - 'Control_RunDLL'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '%AppData%'
        - '%LocalAppData%'
        - '%Temp%'
        - '\AppData\'
        - '\Temp\'
        - '\Users\\Public\'
condition: selection

versions.subject: feat: add missing `OriginalFileName` field (#4026)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'RUNDLL32.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'shell32.dll'
        - 'Control_RunDLL'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '%AppData%'
        - '%LocalAppData%'
        - '%Temp%'
        - '%tmp%'
        - '\AppData\'
        - '\Temp\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\rundll32.exe" OR OriginalFileName="RUNDLL32.EXE" CommandLine="*shell32.dll*" CommandLine="*Control_RunDLL*" CommandLine IN ("*%AppData%*", "*%LocalAppData%*", "*%Temp%*", "*%tmp%*", "*\\AppData\\*", "*\\Temp\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*")
